public_sources.title: TEMPERA: Test-Time Prompting via Reinforcement Learning
public_sources.mechanism_used: A query-adaptive test-time prompt-editing action space can modify instruction, few-shot exemplars and verbalizers, with reinforcement learning used to choose edit actions.

public_sources.title: tianjunz/TEMPERA
public_sources.mechanism_used: Reference code trains a PPO-based editor with Python/conda, model/dataset execution, multiple processes and millions of environment steps; those runtime requirements are not part of the accepted Chat-native route.

distinctness_check.result: No prior own TEMPERA binding was found in the exact role-local directory listing used before this audit.
distinctness_check.claim_scope: Role-local distinctness only; no claim of global novelty.

literal_runtime_assessment.reason: The reference route requires learned RL policy training plus Python/model/dataset execution and substantial environment-step compute. Strict Phase-1-v4 cannot require that external execution or quota-bearing compute.

chat_native_reduction.mechanism: Transfer only TEMPERA's component-addressed, query-adaptive prompt-edit action space into the recurring-Chat controller. Seal an edit trajectory identity, permit edits only in mutable role-local strategy fields analogous to instruction/example/verbalizer components, evaluate each edited candidate only from its own durable same-scope terminal evidence, and stop/switch after a bounded edit budget. Do not transfer PPO training or any learned external executor.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_transport_role: Lightweight role-local state/evidence transport only; transport rate limits are mechanical and cannot become semantic reward or compute.

constructed_conformance.implementation: Deterministic transition-table evaluation in recurring scheduled-Chat reasoning; no external RL trainer, model API, hosted runner or quota-bearing compute used for the tested controller semantics.

exact_scope_result.supported_claim: A bounded TEMPERA-style component-addressed test-time prompt-edit mechanism can be reduced to the sealed textual_edit_search leaf entirely within recurring Chat while preserving restart identity, evidence-before-reward/credit, query-local scope, CLEAN/authority boundaries, bounded exit, and strict Phase-1-v4 zero-residual/zero-quota acceptance on 12 constructed guards.
unsupported_claims: No claim that TEMPERA's PPO policy or benchmark results were reproduced.
No claim that TEMPERA outperforms GrIPS or other prompt optimizers on real workloads.
No claim that the literal Python/RL/model runtime is an accepted Phase-1-v4 route.
No claim of global Phase-1 completion.
